lines.t: There. It'll stay open for good. Catch a gale friend when you can — the wild's full of them.
The vent lifts you to the top tier. A second vent up there drops you back down, so you're never stranded. That's the rule.
The updraft only answers to a Tuner who carries the Mere Hall Keynote. Nerys's note is the one that wakes Gust.
Come back when Sillowmere's Cantor has heard you out. I'll still be here. I'm always here. It's very windy.
Updrafts only lift for a gale voice. No gale kin? Hop on with mine.
That vent wants a gale voice. Not carrying one? I'll lend you mine — just this once.
You again! I never forget a face, or an unpaid tally. Special's changed.
Hauled this wagon up the switchbacks myself. The wheels complained the whole way. So did I.
Saw a kid in a long scarf leap off the top tier and ride the down-draught, whooping the whole way.
Landed in a bush. Got up. Bowed. Ten out of ten, honestly.
Fourteen metres of sheer scarp and not one handhold that isn't a lie. I've tried them all. Twice.
The smart way up is the vent by the Steward. Get a gale kin to sing into it and the updraft carries you like a leaf.
There's a second, sulkier vent east of here, snagged full of lost kites. Galewick's kite-makers would pay to get those back.
Coils are off. Pens are open. I've been reassigned to 'reflection'. There isn't a form for that yet.
The strays all ran home singing. Never heard the Rise so loud. …It's not a bad sound, is it?
Honestly? I joined for the helmet. It's very warm.
Warden Vey's inside, rehearsing. The Warden rehearses everything. Even lunch.
Tea break. Survey Depot No. 3's round the corner, but I'm not supposed to say that. So I didn't.
The Magister says unregulated stones are how people get hurt. She's usually right about hazards.
{player}! Finally! I rode that updraft three times. Twice on purpose.
Look at this place. Brass doors, a sign-in sheet, a *doormat*. Villains shouldn't have doormats.
I heard kin inside. Lots of them. Not happy-noisy. Lost-noisy. Like the fosterage the morning ours bolted.
Big quiet building full of engineers. You take the left wing, I'll take the right. If I scream, it's a strategy.
There you are. I've been standing here doing heroic poses for ten minutes. Nobody came by.
We make a good team. I hate that. Battle me anyway — I need to know if we're even.
Not even. Yet. Keep the gap warm for me.
I took the barrier down while you were saying goodbye to the pens. It was very heavy. I was very brave.
Cindral's west, over the top. Bastian runs the Forge Hall up there. Mum says he's the only Cantor who ever made her sweat.
Literally. It's a volcano. See you at the caldera, {player}!
I'm drawing our starters side by side on the rock. Yours has a bigger head. That's artistic licence, not an insult.
Updrafts only lift for a gale voice. No gale kin? Hop on with mine.
Big quiet building full of engineers. You take the left wing, I'll take the right. If I scream, it's a strategy.
We make a good team. I hate that. Battle me anyway — I need to know if we're even.
Not even. Yet. Keep the gap warm for me.
Even! We're even. Don't argue, I'm savouring it.
